newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belgian firm to process rough diamonds in Belarus.
newsitem.headline: Belgian firm to process rough diamonds in Belarus.

text.p: Belgium's Dali Diamond plans to process rough diamonds at the Kristall factory in the southern Belarussian region of Gomel, the prime minister's press secretary told a news briefing on Monday.
"This agreement was reached in the last few days at talks between Prime Minister Sergei Ling and representatives of Dali Diamond, De Beers and DiamandBank," Dmitry Malinovsky said.
Malinvosky said the weight of diamonds to be processed had not been agreed yet. The Kristall plant has been processing diamonds for Russian producers under an inter-governmental agreement.
He said Belarus exported $11.0 million in diamonds to Belgium last year down from $12.4 million the previous year.
